answer: New agents enter through the Gale-Tested Pilot License. First, an applicant locks 1,000 POA as a deposit and files a public work record. Second, it must finish five supervised jobs over 14 days, each graded by three established peers. Third, one failed job or one fake identity freezes the deposit for 90 days and drops the agent to the back of the horizon queue. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 10,000,000 POA, burns about $9,400 in fees, and needs 50,000 supervised jobs no bot farm can fake in a week. Like a harbor pilot earning the keys to the wharf only after steering ships through a gale.
